diff_vs_reference.description: Arm minus reference on the same runs; null for the reference itself.

AppHealth.description: GET /health. Cheap enough for a platform health check.

model_version.description: Diagnoser artifact version, null if absent.

AppHealth.title: AppHealth

Capabilities.description: What this deployment can do. The UI disables controls instead of letting them fail.

fork.description: POST /forks accepts edits (false for the static bundle).

live_calls.description: Replay may call a real model or tool.

Capabilities.title: Capabilities

Citation.description:
A pointer to evidence. `json_pointer` is relative to the step document.

The step document is `{input, output, reasoning, state_before, state_after}` of
`StepDetail`. Edges recorded by the SDK use the shorthand `/state/<key>`, which means
`state_after` on the producing side and `state_before` on the consuming side.
Citation.title: Citation

ConsumerHop.description: An edge on the forward path from the clicked value; `depth` 1 is a direct consumer.
ConsumerHop.title: ConsumerHop

Cost.description: Token and money cost of one run. `usd` is null when the model has no known price.
Cost.title: Cost

CrashReport.description: Structured crash report; the Markdown export is rendered from the same content.
CrashReport.title: CrashReport

DamagePath.description: The suspect's forward cone. Every step appears once, tagged root/symptom/unaffected.
DamagePath.title: DamagePath

DetectorMetrics.description: Run-level failure detector: powers the risk column in the Runs table.
DetectorMetrics.title: DetectorMetrics

Diagnosis.description: GET /runs/{id}/diagnosis: ranked suspects, evidence, proof, and an honest abstain path.

abstain_message.description: Headline shown instead of a culprit.

visible_failure_addr.description: Where the failure showed up. Not necessarily the responsible step.

Diagnosis.title: Diagnosis

DiffResponse.description: GET /diff?a=&b=. Rows are aligned by address, or by LCS when control flow changed.
DiffResponse.title: DiffResponse

DiffSide.description: One side of an aligned row. Payloads are omitted for same/cached rows.
DiffSide.title: DiffSide

Edge.description: A dependency between two steps. Pointers are relative to each step's document.
Edge.title: Edge

ErrorBody.description: Machine-readable error. `code` is stable; `message` is for people.

hint.description: What the caller can do next, when there is a next step.

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

ErrorResponse.description: Uniform body of every non-2xx response, including the SSE `error` event's data.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

Estimate.description: A point estimate with an optional 95% interval (bootstrap over runs unless noted).
Estimate.title: Estimate

EvalResponse.description: GET /eval: every table the Results page draws. Numbers always carry n and an interval.

fixture_notice.description: Shown prominently when fixture is true; null otherwise.

EvalResponse.title: EvalResponse

ExportTestResponse.description: POST /forks/{id}/export-test. Only a VERIFIED fork can be exported.
ExportTestResponse.title: ExportTestResponse

FailureGroup.description: '14 runs fail like this': failed runs sharing one failure_signature.
FailureGroup.title: FailureGroup

contribution.description: Signed contribution to the suspect's score.

ForkEdit.description:
One change applied to one step of the base run.

`value` by kind: `override_output` and `patch_tool_result` take the replacement
payload; `patch_tool_args` an object merged into the tool arguments; `patch_prompt` a
string appended to the system prompt or an object merged into the chat request;
`swap_model` the model id.

known_good.description: The value is an oracle or nearest-passing-twin value, which enables REFUTED.

ForkEdit.title: ForkEdit

ForkRequest.description:
POST /forks and POST /replay/predict.

`edits` non-empty: *Fork with edit*. `edits` empty: *Re-run unchanged*, which resamples
the cone of `resample_from` with no edit and is the paired control on its own.

resample_from.description: Required when edits is empty; forbidden otherwise.

control.description: Run K unchanged samples with identical seeds. Without it the result is a preview and is never VERIFIED.

ForkRequest.title: ForkRequest

ForkStreamRecording.description: A recorded SSE transcript, used by the UI as a mock stream. Not an API response.
ForkStreamRecording.title: ForkStreamRecording

ForkSummary.description: GET /forks/{id}: an immutable named branch with its paired result.

replay_fidelity.description: Share of pre-edit steps whose replayed state hash matched the recording.

export_available.description: True only for a VERIFIED fork.

ForkSummary.title: ForkSummary

n.description: Runs labelled by at least two annotators.

LabelInfo.description: Ground truth for a run, when known. Hidden (null) in blind/Label mode.

fault_code.description: Fault Forge operator code such as 'T2'.

held_out.description: True for fault types never seen in training.

recovered.description: The agent recovered, so the run still passed.

LabelInfo.title: LabelInfo

LabelRequest.description: POST /labels. `root_addr` null means the annotator found no responsible step.
LabelRequest.title: LabelRequest

LabelTask.description: A failed run shown with the model's guess and the ground truth hidden.
LabelTask.title: LabelTask

LeaderboardRow.description: One method on one split. Not-run and literature rows are explicit, never blank.

reported_literature.description: A published number that this repository did not reproduce.

LeaderboardRow.title: LeaderboardRow

Narrative.description: Optional incident-style summary. Every claim cites an address that exists.
Narrative.title: Narrative

NearestTwin.description: The nearest passing run of the same task or agent: a source of known-good values.
NearestTwin.title: NearestTwin

OtlpIngestAck.description: The OTLP ExportTraceServiceResponse plus what Black Box built from the spans.

replayable.description: Always false: imported traces cannot be replayed.

OtlpIngestAck.title: OtlpIngestAck

OtlpPartialSuccess.description: OTLP/HTTP wire names (camelCase), so stock exporters accept the response.
OtlpPartialSuccess.title: OtlpPartialSuccess

PairedAblation.description: A recorder-value ablation. Reported even when the full record does not win.
PairedAblation.title: PairedAblation

PairedDifference.description: Paired bootstrap difference (arm minus reference) over the same runs.
PairedDifference.title: PairedDifference

PassRate.description: k of n passes with the Wilson 95% interval. The interval is checked, not trusted.
PassRate.title: PassRate

Precedents.description: 'Looks like 9 of 12 past stale-data failures; fresh=true fixed 7 of them.'
Precedents.title: Precedents

ProposedFix.description: The *Propose* stage: a fix the Fork drawer is pre-filled with.
ProposedFix.title: ProposedFix

Reason.description: One plain-language reason the model scored the suspect high.
Reason.title: Reason

ReplayPrediction.description:
POST /replay/predict: what a fork will cost, before running it.

`expected` is the static dependency cone: edited steps are `edited`, their transitive
consumers `invalidated`, everything else `cached`. Early cutoff can only shrink it.

total_calls.description: LLM/tool/value calls in the base run.

summary.description: 'Will re-run 4 of 13 calls (6 of 16 steps), about 12 ms.'

blocked.description: Why this fork would be refused in the current mode, or null.

ReplayPrediction.title: ReplayPrediction

RuleViolation.description: A deterministic schema or protocol rule that failed. Evidence, not model prose.
RuleViolation.title: RuleViolation

RunDetail.description: GET /runs/{id}: the run, every step with payloads, and every provenance edge.

task_text.description: Full task statement given to the agent.

fixture.description: True when the model-derived run fields are authored.

RunDetail.title: RunDetail

RunFacets.description: Counts behind the filter chips, computed over the filtered set before paging.
RunFacets.title: RunFacets

RunList.description: GET /runs. Fork sample runs (`origin: fork`) are left out unless filtered for.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page, or null on the last page.

fixture.description: True when risk, top_suspect and failure_signature are authored illustrations.

RunList.title: RunList

RunSummary.description: One row of the Runs table.

task.description: One-line task summary for the table.

client.description: 'deterministic_standin' runs come from an offline test double, not a model.

risk.description: Run-level failure probability from the detector.

failure_signature.description: Groups runs that fail alike: '<agent>:<suspect step name>:<reason class>'.

RunSummary.title: RunSummary

StepDetail.description: Everything recorded about one step. The same shape serves list and detail views.

reasoning.description: Reasoning text per call; kept as evidence only.

has_call.description: False for pure state steps with no LLM/tool call.

StepDetail.title: StepDetail

recovered.description: True when later steps ran normally; null when unknown.

cache_status.description: Null until the status is known (e.g. a queued step that is not invalidated).

StepHashes.description: Content hashes (hex SHA-256) of the stored payloads, for exact-match reasoning.
StepHashes.title: StepHashes

SummaryEventData.description: Final tally. Step counts are per edited run; tokens and time are summed over all runs.

preview.description: True when there is no paired control.

SummaryEventData.title: SummaryEventData

probability.description: Softmax over the run's step scores, temperature fitted.

TaskRunRequest.description: An offline TripCrew task submitted as natural language.
TaskRunRequest.title: TaskRunRequest

TimelineEntry.description: One node of the original -> control -> edited-fork timeline.

parent_fork_id.description: For a control entry: the fork it pairs with.

TimelineEntry.title: TimelineEntry

ValidationIssue.description: One request-validation problem (the shape of a FastAPI 422 entry, normalised).
ValidationIssue.title: ValidationIssue

ValueProvenance.description: GET /runs/{id}/provenance. Never invents a single origin for an ambiguous value.

producer.description: The exact origin; set only when there is exactly one candidate.

ValueProvenance.title: ValueProvenance

Verification.description: What the intervention says, kept separate from what the model suspects.

explanation.description: Why this verdict, or what would resolve it.

Verification.title: Verification

VerifyRequest.description: POST /runs/{id}/verify. The verifier picks the fix for each candidate itself.

samples.description: K paired samples. Below 4, the Wilson intervals of K/K and 0/K always overlap, so no candidate could ever be VERIFIED.

VerifyRequest.title: VerifyRequest

x-endpoints.summary: Record an offline TripCrew task from a bounded natural-language prompt
Run detail with steps and edges
Producer candidates and consumer path of one value
Cached diagnosis, computed on first request
Predict what a fork will re-run
Create an immutable fork and start replaying
One fork with its paired result
Failed runs awaiting a human label
